highlight.js 11.12.0, from the official highlightjs/cdn-release repository (11-stable branch).
https://github.com/highlightjs/cdn-release/tree/11-stable/build

Bundled files: highlight.min.js, languages/*.min.js, and the default stylesheet
at /css/thirdparty/highlightjs/default.min.css. The license is in LICENSE.
The language filename list is copied to /highlightjs/languages.txt at build time.
